title: Grateful Dead Live at Alpine Valley Music Theatre on 1988-06-20
lineage: Cassette (Nakamichi DR-1) -> Sound Devices 744T (24bit/96k) ->Adobe Audition v3.0 -> Samplitude Professional v11.2.1 -> FLAC/16
source: Set 1: SBD -> Cassette Master -> Cassette (Sony D5/Dolby B)Set 2: SBD -> Cassette Master -> ? -> Cassette

ai_review.summary: Soundboard recording that sounds clear and beats the ultramix despite a slight guitar warble, capturing an energetic 1988 show with Jerry’s voice back in top form.
ai_review.review: The tape is a pure sound‑board capture that offers a clean mix and generally excellent fidelity, though listeners note a faint warble on the guitar through the speakers. Musically the concert is praised for its lively feel and strong first‑set song selection, with Jerry Garcia’s vocals described as “gold” after a few weaker mid‑80s outings.

ai_rating.rationale: One reviewer rates the show average (3★) while another gives it a solid 4★, highlighting strong performance and decent soundboard quality with minor quirks; overall rating leans positive but limited data keeps confidence moderate.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear, well‑balanced mix that outshines the ultramix version, though a slight guitar warble is audible across the speakers.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set praised for its lively song selection and overall verve; the concert feels energetic with strong momentum throughout.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Vocals described as “gold” and back to form after a period of weaker performances.
